models_evaluated: proposed deep learning breast density classification model

links.outcome: Radiologist inter-reader consistency (kappa, ICC) before versus after DL model assistance; overreliance not assessed
links.effect: Two-category K/ICC rose to 0.81, 0.81, 0.80 from 0.73, 0.75, 0.76; four-category rose to 0.81, 0.82, 0.82 from 0.73, 0.79, 0.78. Overreliance was not assessed.
links.quote: The consistency within the junior group, the senior group, and among all radiologists improved with the help of the DL model.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the clinical impact/implementation of a deep learning model for breast density classification before and after implementation, measuring clinician acceptance and inter-reader consistency.
